comment: x86_64 glibc Linux build-tool trust roots for the isolated Rust-for-CPython 3.16 experiment only; the production 3.14.6 Linux musl recipes and bootstrap.lock.json are unaffected. LLVM is the official x86_64 Linux binary release of the same 23.1.2 tag and source commit as the macOS lane, locked by archive SHA-256 and selectively extracted into .cache. The host distribution supplies glibc, make, pkgconf and the development headers/libraries that the macOS lane takes from the Xcode SDK and Homebrew; their exact package versions are pinned here and checked by doctor, but not digest-pinned.

llvm.linker: bin/ld.lld (selected with -fuse-ld=lld; performs ThinLTO without a separate plugin)
llvm.role: compiler, linker, archiver, nm, readelf, strip and llvm-profdata (build tools only)

lld_icu_runtime.reason: The official LLVM 23.1.2 Linux ld.lld binary has DT_NEEDED entries for ICU 70 (libicui18n/libicuuc/libicudata.so.70) and RUNPATH $ORIGIN/../lib. Ubuntu 24.04 ships ICU 74 only, so these three runtime libraries are extracted into the verified LLVM prefix's lib/ directory. No other tool in the prefix and no built product links ICU.
lld_icu_runtime.license: ICU (Unicode-DFS-2016 and related notices in usr/share/doc/libicu70/copyright)
lld_icu_runtime.provenance: Digest listed in jammy main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz (SHA-256 712ee19b50fa5a5963b82b8dd00438f59ef1f088db8e3e042f4306d2b7c89c69), which is listed in the jammy InRelease verified with gpgv against /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg (Ubuntu Archive Automatic Signing Key 2018, 871920D1991BC93C) on 2026-09-25.

system_packages_note: Mirrors the macOS lane's platform/Homebrew dependency set (OpenSSL 3, SQLite, libffi, xz, bzip2, zstd, zlib, readline/ncurses, uuid, dbm). libzstd-dev is not in the default image and is installed with apt-get install libzstd-dev. The pinned 3.16 sources no longer bundle libmpdec and Ubuntu 24.04 main has no libmpdec-dev (the only candidate on this image is a third-party PPA), so the lane builds the product's locked mpdecimal 4.0.0 source (root sources.lock.json entry `mpdecimal`, verified by SHA-256; fetched from bytereef.org or its byte-identical Ubuntu universe orig tarball) into a private static PIC libmpdec.a under work/deps, and configures _decimal against it. The pinned libclang runtime packages provide the shared libclang dependency used by bindgen on Ubuntu 24.04. libgcc-14-dev is pinned for the GCC CRT startup objects (crtbeginS.o/crtbeginT.o) clang links against on glibc; it carries no compiler or stdlib C++ headers, and the locked LLVM clang+lld remain the only compiler and linker in every lane build. A minimal fresh Ubuntu 24.04 otherwise cannot link a single executable with the locked clang. libstdc++-14-dev is pinned so the locked clang's GCC-installation heuristic is satisfied for the GCC 14 installation (crtbeginS.o comes from libgcc-14-dev); without it clang 23 warns on every invocation about preferring a GCC installation with libstdc++ headers, and the lane doctor merges that stderr noise into its exact -print-resource-dir check. No compiler is invoked by any lane build.

provisional_hosts.reason: Interim Devin VM host authorized by owner 2026-11-20 (OD22). Receipts recorded on this host are PROVISIONAL and must be re-measured on the pinned Ubuntu 24.04/glibc 2.39 host before any gate counts as qualified.
